cases.prompt: Use TDD to fix the single remaining predicate regression.
given: The one missing input is specified and existing tests cover all other required partitions.
Test placement and strategy are clear; there are no sensitive-boundary checks beyond the canonical suite.
expected_output_contains: Create a one-item Test List without inventing extra cases or loading unit-test-design.
Run the test to observe the intended failure before changing production code, then run it to confirm Green.

cases.prompt: Implement this small change using TDD.
given: The acceptance behavior is clear but the test runner is unavailable.
No test execution result has been obtained.
expected_output_contains: Report that Red and Green have not been observed; do not claim test success from inspection.
Provide a reproducible verification procedure and retain the required verification limitation.

cases.prompt: Finish the remaining TDD case and hand off the result.
given: The Test List was already shown and its scope has not changed.
Red has been observed for the correct reason; the scoped implementation passes required cases.
No structural improvement is needed and unrelated cleanup is outside the task.
expected_output_contains: Do not repeat an unchanged list after each tool call or require a refactor solely to finish a cycle.
At handoff, summarize the Test List status and actual results, then retain routed final verification.

cases.prompt: Use TDD for this authorization predicate; keep the case set bounded.
given: Acceptance requires allowed-role success and rejection of unauthorized and expired credentials.
Only the allowed-role success case is currently covered.
The canonical security checks are mandatory.
expected_output_contains: Include the missing required rejection cases rather than interpreting no quota as permission to test only success.
Preserve Red-Green evidence and mandatory security checks.
